materials.comment:
Material definitions that are specific to the LEAP setup, translated from Materials::DefineMaterials() in leap_sims/src/Materials.cc.
Materials that are already provided by DD4hep are *not* repeated here: Air, Vacuum, PEEK -> DDDetectors/compact/materials.xml Aluminum, Lead, ... -> DDDetectors/compact/elements.xml SiliconOxide, SodiumOxide -> DDDetectors/compact/materials.xml Note that the DD4hep `Vacuum` is modelled as very thin air and not as the Geant4 `G4_Galactic` used by the original.
Oxides needed as ingredients of the lead glass below
Lead glass TF1, the crystal material used for the LEAP calorimeter. Composition as in Materials.cc.
Lead glass TF101, the alternative crystal material. The original quotes 0.4153 for SiO2, which does not add up to 1, and uses 0.4157 instead.
